steps.name: 01_bridge_pane
steps.desc: The Bridge pane over the map with the fall: the hint says bridges cross calm water, not a waterfall

steps.name: 02_fall
steps.desc: Zoom 10 on the tier fall facing the camera: the curtain, the foam ring and the plunge pool, Bridge tool active

steps.name: 03_refused_fall_hint
steps.desc: A line across the plunge pool just below the fall: drawn red, and 'Too close to the waterfall. Bridges cross calm water.' beside the cursor

steps.name: 04_refused_fall_toast
steps.desc: Released there: nothing is placed and the toast says why

steps.name: 05_upstream_preview
steps.desc: A line across the upper pool about 2.5 m upstream of the lip: the plank bridge previews, allowed

steps.name: 06_upstream_placed
steps.desc: Released: the plank bridge over the calm water above the fall

steps.name: 07_uphill_preview
steps.desc: A river stroke drawn uphill from the low ground onto the tier top, still pressed: the ribbon's chevrons point downhill (toward the bottom of the screen), the way the water will run

steps.name: 08_token_in_pool
steps.desc: In play, zoom 8: a token wading in the plunge pool below the fall shows its submerged ring; another stands in the upper pool under the bridge

steps.title: P4c-5 falls: tools and play
steps.intro: Produced by tools/render_jobs/jobs/falls_tools.json at 1920x1080. A new 150 ft temperate forest map (seed 1234) with a Tier plateau north of the middle and a waist river drawn over its south edge toward the camera (one fall). Then, through real input events, the Bridge tool: a line across the plunge pool just below the fall (refused, the fall's message beside the cursor and as a toast) and a line across the upper pool 2.5 m upstream of the lip (placed); the Water tool: a river stroke drawn uphill onto the plateau held mid-stroke (the ribbon's chevrons point downhill); then the level saved as _p4c_tools and played with a token in the plunge pool (its submerged ring) and one in the upper pool. The test level is deleted at the end.
